title: Rank leads, but the time reading survives

phrase.meaning: then he was among those who believe

points.label: Higher in rank
points.text: **Ibn ʿĀshūr** reads thumma as **al-tarākhī al-rutbī**: what follows outranks what precedes. Faith is the condition for the deeds to count, and “kāna” implies it came first. **Ṭanṭāwī** agrees: faith is the basis for accepting the deeds.

points.label: Later in time
points.text: Deeds done before Islam, faith afterwards. Both cite **Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām**, told by Muhammad: “You accepted Islam **with the good you had already done**.” Al-Qurṭubī also lists: believing, then staying a believer until death.

points.label: Simply “and”
points.text: **Al-Baghawī** and **al-Qurṭubī** report that thumma here means **wa**, “and”. **Jalālayn** call it order of mention only, and **Ibn Kathīr** glosses: a believer at heart, along with these deeds.

bottom_text: No consensus. Ibn ʿĀshūr and Ṭanṭāwī favour rank, with faith making the deeds count, but the Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām hadith keeps the time reading alive.
source_label: Ibn ʿĀshūr, al-Taḥrīr wa-l-Tanwīr on 90:17 · al-Qurṭubī, Jalālayn
